bic_trace_step.reason: In the `stm32_usbphyc_probe` function, the validation of `index` against `usbphyc->nphys` uses `>` instead of `>=` (line: `if (ret || index > usbphyc->nphys)`). Since `usbphyc->nphys` is the count of child nodes, the array `usbphyc->phys` is allocated with that many elements, so valid indices are 0 to nphys-1.
